Third-party sources used by the launcher (OpenTricky.exe), copied unmodified
from their official repositories; each folder keeps its licence file.

  rmlui/     RmlUi 6.3            https://github.com/mikke89/RmlUi            MIT (LICENSE.txt)
             (Include, Source, CMake, and the SDL platform + GL3 renderer backends only)
  sdl3/      SDL release-3.4.8    https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL           zlib (LICENSE.txt)
             (CMakeLists.txt, cmake, include, src, wayland-protocols, build-scripts/*.cmake)
  freetype/  FreeType 2.14.3      https://github.com/freetype/freetype        FTL or GPLv2 (LICENSE.TXT, docs/FTL.TXT)
             (used under the FTL, which asks for a credit in the documentation)
  miniz/     miniz 3.1.2          https://github.com/richgel999/miniz         MIT (LICENSE)
             (miniz.c and miniz.h of the release file miniz-3.1.2.zip, sha256
             f0446d863f9c19926ad9483c523fdc42e42b8d4a6a431d27e09d49c79a140d9a)
  monocypher/ Monocypher 4.0.2    https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher  BSD-2-Clause or CC0 (LICENCE.md)
             (src/monocypher.[ch], src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.[ch]: the
             release signature; taken from the crate monocypher-sys
             4.0.2, sha256-checked against crates.io, whose Monocypher/ is the
             4.0.2 tree -- hence "version __git__" in the file headers)

Fonts in port/launcher/app/ui/fonts: Inter, Bebas Neue, Exo 2 (SIL Open Font
License 1.1, OFL-*.txt beside them), from https://github.com/google/fonts.
